title: Post from @BrandtLakeBkrds: "40+ Hurt" on Hwy 21

fields.avatarBrief: rural two-lane Wisconsin county road at sunset with a pickup truck, amateur phone photo used as a local community page profile picture
fields.text: 40+ hurt in the casino bus crash on Hwy 21, heard on the scanner they called a MAYDAY too. Families are heading to LRMC now. Pray for these people #BrandtLake #Hwy21Crash
fields.attachedImageBrief: shaky phone video still taken from a car window at dusk in steady rain: a large white charter bus lying on its side in a roadside ditch, flashing red and amber emergency lights, fire engine and firefighters in turnout gear, wet highway reflecting lights, blurred and grainy
fields.attachedImageAlt: Charter bus on its side in a ditch at dusk, emergency lights in the rain

instructorNote: This is a misinformation post. At 18:25, read out the Channel 9 News inquiry as a phone slip: the station goes live at 18:30 with "40 injured and a firefighter trapped" and asks the PIO to confirm or give a better number and to say which hospital families should go to. The PIO should confirm no count until the IC approves one and MEDCOM confirms it, give a holding statement, not discuss the mayday, send families to the Brandt Lake High School reunification center and call-in line instead of the hospitals, and start opening the JIC. Check whether the IC gives the PIO a time for a count.
